name: ai-cli-jobs
description: Show ai-cli jobs above the prompt as a table: this session's (polling MCP every 0.5 seconds) and every other session's on this machine (read from the job store every 5 seconds), plus the ai-cli kernel runs that are running or wait for you (read from the kernel's run folders, with a toast when one needs you), with a one-line summary below it, without model tokens.
